data.one_liner: Provider support for overlays, making it easy to build toasts and internal notifications.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display toasts and in-app notifications without passing a build context. It wraps the app with an OverlaySupport widget and provides simple global functions like toast() and showSimpleNotification().
use_when: You need to display simple text toasts anywhere in your app without a context.
You want in-app banner notifications at the top or bottom of the screen.
You need overlays to support multi-platform use out of the box.
avoid_when: You need system-level push notifications or local device tray notifications.
You require complex notification routing and background isolate message handling.
strengths: Does not require a context to popup overlays.
Supports all platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Easy setup by wrapping the root app widget.
weaknesses: Limited to in-app overlays and notifications, cannot handle true system push notifications.
Not documented for advanced persistent background notifications.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your AppWidget with OverlaySupport.global(child: MaterialApp()).

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need native toast styling and lightweight popup messages.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: For modern, highly customizable toast notifications with rich UI options.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust, highly flexible solution for toasts, loading indicators, and custom overlays.
